panels.title: CPU requests / capacity
panels.description: Requests and limits use allocatable node capacity. Values above 100% show overcommit.

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", image!="", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) by (namespace) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="cpu", cluster="$cluster"}) by (namespace)

sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", image!="", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) by (namespace) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="cpu", cluster="$cluster"}) by (namespace)

panels.title: Memory by namespace
panels.description: Container memory working set, including recently used cache.

targets.expr: sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", cluster="$cluster", container!="", image!=""}) by (namespace) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="memory", cluster="$cluster"}) by (namespace)

sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", cluster="$cluster", container!="", image!=""}) by (namespace) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="memory", cluster="$cluster"}) by (namespace)

panels.title: Memory by namespace
panels.description: Container memory working set, including recently used cache.

targets.expr: ceil(sum by(namespace) (rate(container_fs_reads_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", device=~"(/dev/)?(mmcblk.p.+|nvme.+|rbd.+|sd.+|vd.+|xvd.+|dm-.+|md.+|dasd.+)", cluster="$cluster", namespace!=""}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(container_fs_writes_total{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", container!="", cluster="$cluster", namespace!=""}[$__rate_interval])))
